answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 20305 Country: India Title: HOW IMPORTANT IS IT FOR A MUSLIM TO WEAR A CAP DURING HIS SAALATH OR DURING HIS USUAL TIME.WILL HIS PRAYER BE COMPLETE WITHOUT WEARING A CAP IF HE DOES SO. Question: HOW IMPORTANT IS IT FOR A MUSLIM TO WEAR A CAP DURING HIS SAALATH OR DURING HIS USUAL TIME.WILL HIS PRAYER BE COMPLETE WITHOUT WEARING A CAP IF HE DOES SO. Answer ID: 20305 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 452/380/B=1431) Though wearing cap for salah and other time is not fardh or wajib but it is sunnah and from the etiquette of salah. If someone out of meekness and humbleness does not wear a cap in salah his salah would be valid. However, if someone does not wear a cap out of fashion and carelessness his salah would be makrooh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
